papers.title: Massive Gravity is not Positive
papers.abstract: We derive new positivity bounds at finite momentum transfer, assuming a large separation between the mass $m$ of the lightest particle in the effective theory and the mass gap $M$ to new heavy states. Massive gravity parametrically violates these bounds unless the cutoff is within one order of magnitude of the graviton mass $M\lesssim O(10)m$. Non-gravitational effective theories of massive spin-2 particles are similarly bounded.
